mapper.select: SELECT doc_id, kb_id, tenant_id, file_name, file_type, chunk_count, version, owner_id, collection_name, upload_time FROM kb_document WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY upload_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document (kb_id, tenant_id, file_name, file_type, chunk_count, version, owner_id, collection_name, upload_time) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{tenantId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{chunkCount}, #{version}, #{ownerId}, #{collectionName}, #{uploadTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document SET chunk_count = #{chunkCount} WHERE doc_id = #{fileId}
